name: Greater Power Penetration [Psionic]
body:
Your powers are especially potent at breaking through power resistance.

Prerequisite: Power Penetration.

Benefit: When you use the Power Penetration feat, the bonus on manifester level checks to overcome a creature’s power resistance increases to +4 when you maintain psionic focus, and +8 when you expend you psionic focus.
